description: Exact dual certificate of the three-point SDP bound on |S| for the Leech minimal-vector scheme. bound = h[e] + sum_{q free} rho[q] + sum_{q free, q != e} max(0, h[q]); h[q] = obj[q] + <Y1,G_q> + <Y2,Gy_q> + (mu^T Cy)_q - rho[q]; Y_b = sum_i (m_i / 2^den_exp) p_i p_i^T with p_i integer vectors, so Y_b >= 0 by construction.
